cases.title: A saved item survives a new session
given: The approved fixed test user is signed in.
Item A is available and is not in this user's saved-items list.
when: The user signs out, signs back in, and opens the saved-items list.

then.expect: The list contains item A exactly once.

data.setup: Coordinate exclusive use of the shared test account and prepare item A as unsaved. Other saved items may remain.
data.cleanup: Remove this test's saved item A if present, including after partial failure. Leave other account data and the account itself intact.
